name: A Ticket at the Trading Post
summary: A thread from a companion's past, picked up by someone in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: A Ticket at the Trading Post: something on the train left a thread loose, and it picks up in Wickermoor.
stages.hint: Reach Wickermoor Village and be welcomed.

waits.text: Baltus Tolliver at the Trading Post will take up this thread once the village has welcomed us.

stages.journal: Baltus Tolliver had seen a ticket like ours before.
